blockers: The authoritative per-course role assignment lives in the Classroom API response for the caller's own credential; repository tests and fixtures cannot prove that Google returns TEACHER for the wrong caller.

validation_plan.deployment: With two real Google accounts that share one Classroom course under different roles, sign in as the lower-privilege account and request the teacher-only routes for that course; confirm 403 and no roster/grades payload.
validation_plan.local: Review tests/test_user_isolation.py, tests covering teacher routes, and models for composite user scoping; inspect the role extraction and teacher-gate helpers without live Google credentials.

trace.description: Teacher list/detail routes invoke the teacher role gate with session user id.
The gate queries user course roles directly from the Google Classroom API response.
Teacher authorization decisions depend strictly on Classroom API membership output.
